_status: IMPORTED 2026-08-05. Consolidated from Grok research rounds, structurally checked, registered in src/data/index.ts.
_note: Grok round 7 — the remaining 14 EU member states plus a corrected Belgium (National Bank of Belgium, not Statbel) and Croatia. Closes EU-27 coverage: every member state now has a documented ESA 2010 edge. Zero surprises — all sixteen used binding member-state language ('shall', 'must', 'in compliance with', 'applies as law'), confirming EU membership predicts binding obligation language with no exceptions found across all 27 states.
